title: docs(check-driver-conformance): retire the undated ratios from the watch-hint docblock
body:
Fixes #15313

Clause-②: no

The docblock over `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` in `scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs`
argued why the declared hint is the drivers subtree and not the top-level root, and
argued it with measured ratios carrying no date. The bare-root worklist row that judges
the **same declaration** re-measured both terms together on one tree and recorded the
previous reading as `superseded WHOLE, neither term carried forward` — so the two
documents disagreed in print, and the undated copy read as current.

## The shape chosen: drop the digits, keep the argument, point at the one dated home

The card offered two shapes (re-measure and date, **or** drop the digits and keep the
shape of the argument). This takes the second, plus an explicit pointer: the paragraph
now defers to the dated authority instead of carrying a copy of it.

Why not re-measure and date here: that would create a **third** copy of a pair whose two
existing copies are what this card is about, and the terms move fast enough that a
written pair is stale by design. Measured under an fs recorder in this worktree at
**2026-09-19T01:16Z**, branch tip `5eebc9ed`, tree `7d5f5da3`:

| term | docblock (undated) | worklist row (2026-09-04, `2200f8ec`) | measured here (2026-09-19, `5eebc9ed`) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| tracked files the walk opens under the drivers subtree | 259 | 344 | **398** |
| tracked files under that subtree | 291 | 379 | **434** |
| tracked files under the top-level root | 4903 | 5979 | **6979** |
| ratio at the subtree | 89% | 90.8% | **91.7%** |
| ratio at the top-level root | 5.3% | 5.8% | **5.7%** |

Every term moved again in the fifteen days since the dated re-measurement — the bare-root
denominator by a thousand files. The argument's **conclusion** is unchanged and was never
digit-dependent, which is what the paragraph now says in structural terms: the walk starts
under `DRIVERS_DIR` and never climbs out, so the subtree hint cannot under-name the
population and the top-level root can only dilute it; the declaration errs **wide**, never
narrow. The dated pair keeps exactly one home, cited by row key rather than copied. Citing
that file from a gate docblock is the existing idiom here (`scripts/check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs`
does it twice).

## Two further undated sites in the same file, same treatment

1. `## Why CASE_SETS_DIR is deliberately NOT declared` carried `143 tracked files of which
   this gate reads 7 (4.9%)`. Measured today: **8 of 167 (4.8%)** — the numerator was wrong
   too, a case set having been added since. This population has **no** worklist row to defer
   to (it is absent from the hint array rather than a declared hint the sweep passes over),
   so there is nothing to point at: the digits go and the structural claim stays.
2. Two `--self-test` assertion **labels** re-spelled the same ratios in their failure text
   (`4903 files to reach 259`, `7 of 143 files`). Label text only; ⛔ no assertion
   **condition** was touched.

## Not touched

- The **value** of `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` — `grep -c 'ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS = \|SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR\|SELF_TEST_BATTERIES'`
  over the diff reads **0**. This card changes the argument, not the declaration.
- The **value** of `CASE_SETS_DIR`.
- `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` (11 entries, same per-battery counts) and `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR = 11`,
  read before and after and identical.
- `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` — out of scope by the dispatch, and by the lane table a
  non-gate `scripts/pm/**` is not this seat's surface. Nothing there needs to change: its row
  is now the sole dated home, which is the disposition this PR subordinates to.

## Verification

Both batteries, which are two different things in this repo, run separately before and after:

| battery | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `node scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs --self-test` | exit 0 | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs` (bare) | exit 0 | exit 0 |

The two verdict texts are byte-identical before and after (`diff` clean apart from the exit
line appended to the before captures) — expected, since the change is comment and label text.

Residual reading with a firing control, both taken from the probed file after the commit:
the removed terms (`4903`, `259`, `291`, `143`, `89%`, `5.3%`, `4.9%`, `17x`) each read **0**
in the file and appear in `git diff BASE HEAD` on removal lines only; the controls, chosen
after the fact as the highest-frequency identifiers absent from the diff, are `dialect`
(in-file 130, in-diff 0) and `ledger` (in-file 94, in-diff 0) — the probe fires.

Gates: derived in-worktree with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`
over the real changed set — 29 commands, all green (six first returned exit **3**,
`PREREQUISITE NOT MET — nothing was measured`, and were re-run green after `pnpm install`).
By the tool's own warning that is not a complete account of CI.

`skip-changeset`, verified rather than assumed: the root manifest is `private: true`, and all
81 non-private packages declare a `files[]` with no entry escaping its own package directory,
so the repo-root `scripts/` tree ships no published byte.
